seoTitle: How to Resend a Google Workspace Invite (2026)
metaDescription: Learn how to resend a Google Workspace invitation to a user who missed the original email, without deleting or recreating their account.
intro: New users sometimes miss their original Google Workspace invitation email or the link expires before they act on it. This guide shows admins how to resend the invite quickly without having to delete and recreate the account.

steps.heading: Locate the pending user
steps.body: In the Admin Console's Users section, find the account that shows a pending or unaccepted invitation status.

steps.heading: Check the invite status
steps.body: Confirm the user hasn't already activated the account under a different email or device before resending.

steps.heading: Resend the invitation
steps.body: Select the option to resend the activation email, which sends a fresh link to the user's registered address.

steps.heading: Confirm delivery and troubleshoot if needed
steps.body: If the user still doesn't receive it, check for typos in their email address or spam filtering issues on their end.

steps.heading: Help the user activate their account
steps.body: Once they receive the resent invite, guide them through clicking the link and setting up their password to complete activation.

faq.question: How long does a Google Workspace invite remain valid?
faq.answer: Invitation links typically remain valid for a limited window, often a few days to a couple of weeks, before they expire and need to be resent.

faq.question: Can I resend an invite without deleting the user account?
faq.answer: Yes, resending an invite doesn't require deleting or recreating the account — it simply sends a new activation email to the same pending user.

faq.question: Why might a user not receive their Google Workspace invite?
faq.answer: Common causes include a typo in the email address, the message landing in spam, or the original link having expired before they clicked it.

faq.question: Is resending an invite different for a school or business account?
faq.answer: The process is largely the same across account types, though education accounts may have slightly different default settings for invite expiration.
